notes: Grip High Evolutionists during Tempest Stormshield and pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell for predictable magic or poison effects.
Anti-Magic Zone covers planned group pulses such as Ritual of the Fang; Death's Advance helps with repeated knockbacks and targeted slows.
Use Death Grip to reposition susceptible casters and cancel channels, while keeping Mind Freeze for true school lockouts.
Anti-Magic Shell is valuable on the first boss trio and Ziekket even where the encounter damage is presented as Nature, Physical, or Holy.
Track armor-reduction stacks before combining packs; intermittent Frostfang magic damage still gives Anti-Magic Shell value.
Control boss positioning deliberately around Hoardmonger resources and Nalorakk's Onslaught shelter rather than leaving either sequence to chance.
Death Grip can cancel susceptible channels such as Health Funnel and Seduction, but it remains displacement rather than interrupt coverage.
Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell for Envenom or Corroding Spittle and track physical bleeds and parry-punishing attacks separately.
Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell for Melt Armor and selected boss debuffs, but keep it aligned with the planned Void Blast defensive cycle.
Use Death Grip for susceptible non-interrupt stops; positioning and route choice remain the primary tank responsibilities.
Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell for magic trash debuffs and the new magic-compatible tankbusters on Merektha and the Avatar guardians.
Do not assume every visually elemental hit is magical; keep ordinary tank mitigation for physical events.
Use Gorefiend's Grasp, Death Grip, and slows to keep Animated Gold away from the Golden Serpent.
Control Undead can retain a Royal Berserker or Hex Priest; refresh before five minutes and plan for control to break on death.
Death Grip cancels a susceptible Ice Shield channel so Mind Freeze can remain available for Frostbolt or Frigid Shard.
Use Blinding Sleet to reset stacking Tectonic Strike and Anti-Magic Shell to mitigate Kokia's Searing Blows damage-over-time component.

recommendations: Blinding Sleet supplies an area stop; Gorefiend's Grasp can gather susceptible targets, while Abomination Limb is less predictable.
There is no dedicated Blood utility answer; commit normal priority damage.
Move toward the group early; March of Darkness is only a minor optional mobility improvement.
Do not pre-immune with Anti-Magic Shell; allow application and use Death Strike to satisfy the healing requirement.
Blood's base kit does not remove the associated snare outright.
